response.sql: WITH base_data AS (SELECT t.tradekind, tr.transreg FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), counts_by_trader_type AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) as transaction_count FROM base_data GROUP BY tradekind), with_totals AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, CAST(transaction_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS NUMERIC) as share, AVG(CAST(transaction_count AS NUMERIC)) OVER () as avg_count FROM counts_by_trader_type), above_average AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, share, avg_count FROM with_totals WHERE transaction_count > avg_count) SELECT SUM(transaction_count) as sum_of_counts, AVG(share) as average_of_shares, AVG(CAST(transaction_count AS NUMERIC) - avg_count) as average_excess FROM above_average
